name: Test Case 1
description: Verify that the user can log in with valid credentials.

steps.expected: User should be redirected to the dashboard.

expectedResult: User successfully logs in and is redirected to the dashboard.

name: Test Case 2
description: Verify that the user cannot log in with invalid credentials.
expectedResult: User cannot log in and an error message is displayed.

name: Test Case 3
description: Verify that the user can reset their password.

steps.expected: User should be redirected to the password reset page.

expectedResult: User receives a password reset confirmation message.
